tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: gu ru'i thugs dam 'khor ba dong sprug las: sgrub thabs snying por dril ba bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈ thugs dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag gzhan 'khor ba las sgrol phyir: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: thugs rje phrin las gcig bsdus pa: de bzhin gshegs pa spyan ras gzigs: 'khor ba dong sprug sgrub pa'i thabs: rgyud lung mang po'i don bsdus te: pad+ma bdag gis dgod par bya: de la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes: dang po skyabs sems tshogs gsag ni: hūm̐: rang rig rtsa ba gsum gyi dngos: mchog gsum 'dus pa lhag pa'i lha: 'khor ba dong sprug lha tshogs la: gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi: mchod cing sdig pa thams cad bshags: yi rang bskul zhing mi 'da' gsol: dge tshogs 'gro ba yongs la bsngo: 'khor ba dong nas sprug pa'i phyir: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: de nas mchod pa byin rlabs ni: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos rnams thams cad stong par gyur: stong pa'i ngang las snang srid kun: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por gsal: kun bzang mchod sprin chen por gyur: oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ: dngos gzhi'i ting 'dzin bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: snang srid 'khor 'das gdod nas stong: kun khyab snying rje 'gro la bsgom: hrīḥyig dmar po'i 'phro 'du yis: snod bcud thugs rje'i zhing du gyur: de dbus pad+ma zla ba'i steng: rang nyid hrīḥlas spyan ras gzigs: 'khor ba dong sprug sku mdog dmar: khye 'u gzhon nu'i ngang tshul la: me tog phreng ba du mas brgyan: ral pa'i zur phud dar gyis bcings: phyag g.yas pad+ma'i phreng ba 'dren: g.yon pas khrus kyi bum pa 'dzin: dar gyi ang rag mdzes par gsol: zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs: 'od phung 'bar ba'i klong du gsal: spyi bor rigs bdag 'od dpag med: dmar gsal sprul sku'i cha lugs can: chos gos gsum gsol skyil krung bzhugs: mnyam gzhag phyag rgyas lhung bzed 'dzin: pad+ma zla ba'i gdan du gsal: bdag gi thugs kar zla ba'i steng: hrīḥmathar yi ge drug pas bskor:

ye shes lnga yi dbang bskur zhing: sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlab: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: shar phyogs po ta la yi zhing: ngo mtshar bkod pa khyad 'phags nas: thugs rje chen po spyan 'dren gyis: da lta nyid du gshegs su gsol: lus la sku yi byin gyis rlobs: ngag la gsung gi byin chen phob: yid la thugs kyi ye shes spor: dbang mchog ma lus bskur du gsol: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: e h+ye hi badz+ra sa ma ya dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: ār+ya a ba lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri bā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pū dza ho: hūm̐: rgyal kun 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs che: byin rlabs thugs rje'i gter chen po: 'khor ba dong nas sprug mdzad pa: thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas: rgyal ba kun mchod byin rlabs bsdus: 'gro ba'i las sgrib kun sbyangs te: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par byas: snang srid thugs rje'i zhing du gyur: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: 'khor ba dong sprug sngags kyang bzla: oṃ bi pu la gar+bhe ma ṇi pra bhe ta thā ga ta dha ri sha ni ma ṇi ma ṇi su pra bhe bi ma le sā ga ra gam+bhi re hūm̐ hūm̐ dz+wa la dz+wa la bud+dha bi lo ki te: gu h+ya a dhiṣ+ṭhi te gar+bhe swā hā: pad+ma dhā ra a mo gha dza ya te tsu ru tsu ru swā hā: gzhan don bum pa bsgrub 'dod na: pad+ma zla ba'i gdan steng du: bh+rūm̐ las bum pa gzhal yas khang: bdud rtsi'i dbus su pad zla la: hrīḥlas thugs rje chen po'i sku: 'khor ba dong sprug sku mdog dmar: phyag gnyis pad phreng bum pa 'dzin: dar dang me tog rgyan gyis bklubs: bzhengs stabs spyi bor 'od dpag med: thugs kar zla steng hrīḥyig la: sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar gsal: sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas: bum pa yongs su gang bar gyur: chu yi zegs ma re re yang: 'khor ba dong sprug sku ru gsal:

gang gi kha ru song tshad rnams: 'khor ba dong sprug mthu ldan bsam: yig drug dong sprug sngags kyang bzlas: mchod bstod la sogs gong bzhin bya: rjes su gshegs bsdu shis smon ni: ye shes gshegs shing dam tshig pa: hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyis bsdu ldang bya: hūm̐: thugs rje'i lha tshogs bsgrubs pa'i mthus: bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams: 'khor ba dong nas sprug pa dang: thugs rje chen po'i sku thob shog: byin rlabs mkha' la sprin 'khrigs bla ma'i tshogs: thugs rje char 'beb yi dam spyan ras gzigs: dgos 'dod 'bras bu smin mdzad mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog: de ltar thugs rje'i sgrub thabs 'di: gang dang 'brel tshad grol bar 'gyur: phyi rabs rnams kyis nyams su longs: bod yul kun la phan pa'i chos: las can rnams kyi thugs la zhog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: o rgyan mchog gyur bde chen gling pas mdo khams mkha' 'gro 'bum rdzong gi dbu rtse pad+ma dbang phug nas khrom gter du spyan drangs pa'o/// / 1$0000250༁ྃ: gu ru'i thugs dam 'khor ba dong sprug las: smin byed byin rlabs sprin phung bzhugs so: 1$0000300ྈྈྈ thugs dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo: 'gro 'dul 'khor ba dong sprug gi: smin byed dbang gi cho ga ni: dkyil 'khor mtshan rdzogs bum pa bsham: lnga phrag lnga yi rdzas kyis bkang: bdud rtsi thod pa kha bkab la: me long gtor ma sku 'bag bsham: phrin las sngon 'gros dbang blangs nas: slob ma thams cad bgegs dang phral: maṇ+ḍal phul la bgegs bskrad nas: ho: 'khor ba dong nas sprug bya'i phyir: bla ma thugs rje chen po yis: bdag cag rjes su bzung nas kyang: dbang mchog ma lus bskur du gsol: slob ma rgyud sbyang tshogs bsags nas: ye shes dbab cing brtan par bya: de nas bum pa spyi bor bzung: hūm̐: rin chen bum pa gzhal yas khang: nang na thugs rje'i lha tshogs bzhugs:

chu ni ye shes bdud rtsir gyur: 'khor ba dong nas sprug bya'i phyir: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: lus kyi sgrib pa kun dag nas: lus snang thugs rje'i lha ru shar: sku yi dbang bskur yongs rdzogs shog: sngags mthar: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: lung 'bogs bdud rtsi khar sbyin cing: spro na sngags byang phreng ba gtad: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings kyi bhan+dha ru: rgyal ba thams cad mnyam sbyor ba'i: byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis bkang: 'khor ba dong nas sprug bya'i phyir: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ngag gi sgrib pa kun dag nas: ngag rlung rdo rje'i sgra ru gyur: gsung gi dbang bskur yongs rdzogs shog: sngags mthar: wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: stong nyid ngo sprod me long bstan: hūm̐: me long stong pa dbyings kyi ngang: rig pa hrīḥyig 'od du 'bar: mthong ba tsam gyis grol 'gyur ba: 'khor ba dong nas sprug bya'i phyir: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: yid kyi sgrib pa kun dag nas: sems ni ye shes chen por gyur: thugs kyi dbang rnams yongs rdzogs shog: sngags mthar: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: gtor ma sku 'bag spyi bor bzung: hūm̐: gtor ma rin chen gzhal yas khang: nang du thugs rje spyan ras gzigs: 'khor ba dong sprug lha tshogs bzhugs: sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya 'phro: 'khor ba dong nas sprug bya'i phyir: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: lus la sku yi dbang bskur bas: gzugs snang thugs rje chen por gyur: ngag la gsung gi dbang bskur bas: sgra skad yi ge drug mar gyur: yid la thugs kyi dbang bskur bas: stong nyid snying rje rtogs par shog: phyi yi nad gdon kun sel zhing: nang gi nyon mongs kun sbyongs shig: gsang ba'i rnam rtog bdud tshogs thul: tshe dang bsod nams ye shes spel: 'brel tshad grol bar byin gyis rlobs: sngags mthar: kā ya bā ka tsit+ta sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī:

dam tshig khas blang gtang rag 'bul: rjes kyi bya ba spyi bzhin bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: o rgyan mchog gyur bde chen gling pas mdo khams mkha' 'gro 'bum rdzong gi dbu rtse pad+ma dbang phug nas khrom gter du spyan drangs pa'o/// / 1$0000250༁ྃ: gu ru'i thugs dam thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dong sprug las: 'gro don bya ba'i chos drug bzhugs so: 1$0000300ྈྈྈྈ thugs dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo: de nas 'gro don chos drug la: dang po myong grol dam rdzas ni: sngon gyi rig 'dzin thams cad kyis: bsgrubs pa'i phabs la gzhi blangs nas: 'phel gdung byin rten sel med dang: nas dkar phye mas bung bskyed la: ril bu yungs dkar tshad tsam bya: kha dog dmar po'i rtsi yis bsgyur: sgrom mam bum pa'i nang du blug: dkyil 'khor 'dab brgyad dbus su bzhag: rigs lnga'i kha rgyan gzungs thag btags: phrin las tshul bzhin btang nas su: bh+rūm̐ las snod mchog gzhal yas khang: bcud kyi ril bu re re bzhin: 'khor ba dong sprug sku ru gsal: thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas: rgyal kun mchod cing byin rlabs bsdus: 'gro ba'i las sgrib kun sbyangs nas: 'od zer sngags kyi phreng bar gyur: lha tshogs thugs ka'i hrīḥl phog: hrīḥlas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i thugs rgyud bskul: 'khor ba dong sprug rnam par byon: ril bu rnams la thim pa yis: 'khor ba dong sprug mthu ldan bsam: sngags 'di rgyun mi chad par dbyangs: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: a ra pa tsa mi ta hṛ da ya swā hā: 'khor ba dong sprug sngags kyang bzla: mthar ni bum pa spyi bor bzhag: hūm̐: rang byung thugs rje'i lha tshogs rnams: thugs rje phrin las bsam mi khyab: khyod kyi thugs rje 'jug yul ni: dam rdzas myong grol 'di yin pas: sngon gyi thugs dam ji bzhin du: myong grol rdzas kyi dbang bskur bas: 'khor ba dong nas sprug par mdzod:

oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: a su pre du nṛ tri ye: duḥkhaḥphaṭa phaṭa sarba pā paṃ phaṭa: phaṭaḥshud+dhe shud+dhe bi shud+dhe dza ya dza ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: ril bu khar sbyin de yi tshe: ril bu 'khor ba dong sprug sku: dmar gsal pad phreng bum pa 'dzin: bzhengs stabs 'od dpag dbu rgyan can: til 'bru tsam zhig snying kha ru: byang chub bar du bzhugs pa dang: sdig sgrib nad gdon kun zhi zhing: tshe dang bsod nams spel ba dang: nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe: de dang dbyer med gyur nas kyang: bde ba can du 'dren par shog: rten snying brjod cing me tog 'thor: rjes kyi mjug bsdu rig pas dpyad: myong grol rdzas kyi 'gro don no: mthong grol 'khor lo'i 'gro don ni: shing la dkar rtsi legs par byugs: 'khor lo mu khyud gsum du bya: lte bar hrīḥdang gnyis pa la: pad+ma 'dab drug yig drug mtshan: gsum par dong sprug gzungs kyang bri: rab gnas tshul bzhin byas nas su: grong khyer srang mdo sgo dag tu: btags na mthong tshad grol bar 'gyur: sa ma ya: bskor grol reg grol dran grol ni: rdo la yig bdun tshul bzhin brko: kha dog dmar po'i rtsi yis byugs: dong sprug skur bsgom yig drug bzla: mchod bstod dang ni rab gnas bya: lam gyi srang mdo chen por bzhag: bskor dran reg mthong de dag grol: sa ma ya: rang nyid 'khor ba dong sprug bsgom: khrom chen 'dus pa'i dbus su song: lce ni pad+ma 'dab brgyad la: dbus dang 'dab tu yig bdun bsgom: sngags kyi rang sgra sgrog pa yi: thos tshad thams cad grol bar bsam: sems bskyed rnam par dag pa yis: snyan po skad gsang mthon po yis: yi ge bdun pa dbyangs su len: de yis thos tshad thams cad grol: dar la yi ge bdun pa bri: rab gnas tshul bzhin byas nas su: sems bskyed rnam par dag pa yis: ri rtse lam srang dag tu 'dzug: rlung de phog tshad grol bar 'gyur:

yig bdun rdo la brkos nas su: rab gnas tshul bzhin byas pa dag: drang srong ṛ ṣi shar ba na: chu bor chen po'i dbus su bzhag: dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa 'bul: smon lam rgya chen btab pa yis: chu bor khrus byas 'thung reg grol: dong sprug gzungs dang yig bdun dag: shing sna spos kyi rigs dag la: khri phrag bdun gyi phus btab pa: mer bsreg dud pa phog tshad grol: mi khyis ma 'gong bye ma la: gong bzhin sngags la shi tshad kyi: ro dang rus bu dur khrod du: gtor na de dag grol bar 'gyur: de kun tshor grol reg grol lo: sa ma ya: de nas btags pas grol ba ni: shog bu 'am ni dar ras la: mthong grol bzhin du bris nas su: rab gnas ldan pas btags tshad grol: yang na srad bu dmar po la: mdud pa bdun byas yig bdun bsam: yig bdun khri yis bsgrubs nas su: btags na srung zhing btags tshad grol: ro yi spyi bor btags pas grol: de ni btags pas grol ba 'o: gzhan yang me long mthong grol ni: me long nang du mthong grol sbyar: phyi ru hrīḥyig dmar po bri: lha ru bsgoms nas ye shes pa: spyan drangs bstim zhing mchod bstod bya: yig bdun 'bum dang gzungs stong gis: bsgrubs te slar yang 'od zhu bas: ngo bo thugs rje chen po la: rnam pa mthong grol 'khor lo bzhin: 'od zer kun tu 'phro bar bsgom: mthong tshad grol ba'i sems bskyed de: rnal 'byor rang gi zhwa thod du: sbyar na mthong tshad grol bar 'gyur: de ltar bya ba gang byas pa: 'gro ba'i don du 'gyur ba yi: chos 'di nyams len byed pa'i mi: yi dam thugs rje chen po yin: de phyir skal ldan snying la zhog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: o rgyan mchog gyur bde chen gling pas mdo khams mkha' 'gro 'bum rdzong gi dbu rtse pad+ma dbang phug nas khrom gter du spyan drangs pa'o/// / 1$0000250 ༁ྃ: gu ru'i thugs dam spyan ras gzigs 'khor ba dong sprug las:

lo rgyus shel gyi phreng ba bzhugs so: 1$0000300ྈྈྈ thugs dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo: 'gro 'dul pad+ma bdag nyid kyis: da lta'i rje 'bangs mched lcam dang: phyi rabs rnams la phan pa'i phyir: rgyal ba ma lus thams cad kyi: thugs rje phrin las gcig bsdus pa: gdod ma'i mgon po dbyer med pa'i: thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs: de yi sprul pa bsam mi khyab: rigs lnga sems dpa' sangs rgyas stong: thub pa drug dang lha lha mo: zhi ba dang ni zhi ma khro: khro bo dang ni nying sprul tshogs: 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshul bstan cing: sprul pa snang tshul du ma yis: 'khor ba dong nas lan mang sprugs: khyad par thub pa gangs chen mtsho: mgon po tshe dpag snang mtha' yas: khro rgyal rta mgrin dmar nag dang: cir yang rnam pa tha dad kyang: pad+ma nga dang gnyis su med: rgyal ba kun las lhag pa yi: thugs rje phrin las rab mnga' zhing: khyad par bod khams kha ba can: 'di nyid 'phags pa'i 'dul zhing yin: de phyir thugs rje myur ba dang: byin che 'brel grol yin pa'i phyir: rgyud lung kun gyi don bsdus nas: thugs rje'i sgrub thabs mang po brtsams: bod yul kun tu ches cher spel: byis pa smra shes tsam la yang: yig drug bzla ru shes par byas: gangs can ljongs 'dir skyes tshad la: ngan song med par bdag gis byas: sa 'og kun kyang gter gyis bkang: gter chen gter phran gang la yang: thugs rje'i sgrub thabs sna re yod: 'brel tshad don dang ldan par 'gyur: 'di ni thugs rje chen po yi: 'khor ba dong nas sprug mdzad pa'i: sgrub thabs gzhan las ches 'phags pa: khyad par can gyi sgrub thabs 'di: thugs rje chen por zhus nas su: skabs thob de dag rnams su spel: mthar ni shog ser ngos la bris: gter kha gsum du sbas pa yin: 'di ni 'bum rdzong dbang phug tu: zab mo'i gter du bstsal ba yin: nam zhig phyi rabs dus kyi tshe: dge sbyong zhig gis bod rgyal byed:

mtha' mi'i yul du btson du khrid: lha sa'i sde srid shrīs byed: stod nas dmag gi g.yab 'dor 'ong: res bde res mi bde ba dang: khyad par lcags sprel lo zhig la: bod 'dir bkra mi shis pa 'byung: de sngon me 'brug me sbrul lo: gang yin gcig la zab gter 'di: sa yi steng du thon par 'gyur: 'di nyid 'don pa'i skyes bu yang: mdo khams lho rgyud zal mo sgang: de ru skyes bu mchog ming zhig: 'dul zhing kha lo bsgyur ba 'byung: de dus khri srong bai ro dang: lang gro gnyags chen shud bu dang: rgyal ba mchog dbyangs g.yu sgra snying: mtsho rgyal 'brom bza' byang chub sgron: zur bza' bu mo me tog sgron: dpal gyi ye shes lha dpal dang: dpal gyi dbang phyug 'brog mi dpal: mu khri btsad po 'o bran dang: sngags 'chang las rab shud bu bza': ban+dhe rdor rgyal chos bzang sogs: khams kyi phyogs su 'byung bar 'gyur: gtsang gi g.yas ru g.yon ru la: nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po dang: nam mkha'i snying po rtse mang dang: dpal brtsegs cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan: rma thog rat+na khye 'u chung: dbus kyi skyi shod g.yas g.yon du: ye shes 'od dang ā tsar+yā: mu tig btsan po ye shes dbyangs: byang chub sgron la sogs pa 'byung: lho brag mon gyi phyogs dag tu: rgyal ba byang chub klu'i dbang po: rgyal ba'i blo gros la sogs 'byung: thang lha gangs rgyud phyogs dag tu: dpal dbyangs dpal rdor bon nam mkha': 'jam dpal spyan gzigs nga sprul 'byung: de rnams kun gyis thugs rje'i bstan pa spel: rang byung thugs rje'i sgrub thabs 'di: bod yul kun la phan pa'i chos: zab cing kha tshang don 'dril la: sgrub thabs snying por bsdus pa dang: smin byed byin rlabs sprin phung dang: 'gro don byed pa'i chos drug dang: lo rgyus shel gyi phreng ba yod: de las mang nyung byung ba na: chad lhag byung ba'i skyon yin no: rang byung thugs rje'i snying po 'di:

gang gis lan gcig brjod pas kyang: 'khor ba dong nas sprug par 'gyur: 'khor ba dong sprug ril bu 'di: bdag dang rje 'bangs stong phrag gis: sgrub tshe thugs rje'i lha tshogs rnams: dngos su thim pas sus myong ba: thugs rje chen por gnyis su med: gzhan yang 'di las ches cher spel: ril bu re la khri re sgrubs: yig drug khri phrag re bzlas nas: ril bu su dang sus myong ba: ngan song med par the tshom med: de phyir kun tu ci 'phel mdzod: bod khams bde thabs de las med: 'di dag byung ba'i rjes dag nas: rang byung thugs rje'i sgrol sku dang: zur bza'i thugs dam skor drug rnams: da lta'i lha sras yab yum gnyis: de dus lhan cig 'byung nas su: rang rang dbang skal len par 'gyur: der 'tshogs mang po ngo mtshar skyed: pad+ma ngas kyang rab gnas 'thor: bod 'bangs thugs la de ltar zhog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:
o rgyan mchog gyur bde chen gling pas mdo khams mkha' 'gro 'bum rdzong gi dbu rtse pad+ma dbang phug nas khrom gter du spyan drangs pa'o/// /
